prd_section: 3.1 保证金模式 → 全仓 → 单一／多资产；切换多资产需要把所有逐仓仓位切换成全仓

endpoints.mutation: POST /fapi/v3/multiAssetsMargin; multiAssetsMargin string true/false, no symbol

contract_checks: Official asset-mode GET and POST apply to Every symbol in the account
Read multiAssetsMargin is required JSON boolean; multi/single explicitly map to string true/false at write boundary
Full-account position configuration groups by symbol, validates BOTH or complete LONG/SHORT, margin coherence, exact Decimal amounts and isolated collateral
Existing nonzero isolated positions or retained isolated collateral block multi-assets target; empty isolated config and cross positions do not
Single-asset target uses exchange eligibility rather than applying the multi-assets isolated-position restriction backwards
No unsupported error codes are invented: unknown errors retain safe existing read-failure reason and numeric code; raw messages never reach UI
Exact signed body, shared fresh nonce, chainId 1666, current wallet both user and signer; no symbol, marginType, dualSidePosition, API key or extra wallet
POST acknowledgement does not prove final mode; separate signed GET records observation and UTC time
reference_boundary: Reference informs supported-mode checks, context validity and explicit mutation boundaries. Its Hip3 backend does not define Aster multiAssetsMargin.
implementation_boundaries: No automatic private read on entry; explicit mode and position read requires two signatures
30-second lease starts at first response including second signature/read; account events or any settings mutation invalidate prior confirmations
Preflight is not an atomic exchange lock; balance requirements, eligible collateral, supported assets and final acceptance are Aster validation
No automatic symbol margin conversion, closing, order cancellation, asset exchange or transfer
All four settings serialize activity; unresolved writes block other settings until GET-only recovery; no automatic POST retry
Submission marks balance/risk/ADL/order snapshots historical; result does not synthesize financial fields or refresh them automatically
Independent settings route not yet integrated into live order-entry / quick orders
No real private request or financial action sent; real authorized EOA/Privy acceptance remains unverified
